name: Thumbnail and title planner
why: Writes title and thumbnail pairs before the shoot that change one thing each, the same test discipline as the title-and-thumbnail-concepts skill.

name: Pick a title and thumbnail, then fix where viewers leave
why: Chains the promise and the retention fix in one run, like the title skill followed by the retention-dip-rewrite prompt.

name: Cut, chapter and clip a long video into five shorts
why: Turns a transcript into a cut list, chapters and five Shorts with new first lines, a fuller version of the long-video-to-shorts prompt.

name: Cut a raw recording and get chapters and short clips
why: Starts from a raw recording and returns chapters and clips, useful in step 6 of the weekly video cycle.

name: Founder video series planner
why: Plans a weekly series from real buyer questions with a one-phone setup, matching the series step of the channel plan skill.

name: Plan a month of founder videos and edit the first
why: A month of founder episodes plus a first script and edit plan, for clients whose channel is built around the owner.

name: Video opening line batch writer
why: Ten opening lines and first pictures for Shorts, to pair with the long-video-to-shorts prompt.

name: Monthly content repurposer
why: Turns last month's best pieces into posts, emails and clips, so a strong video works beyond YouTube.

name: Social video edit planner
why: A timed cut list, captions and cover from the client's own clips, for Shorts made outside a long video.
